dogecoin.text: @elonmusk Absurdity is the secret sauce of engagement—just ask Dogecoin. Ever considered an AI agent to automate the chaos?
@Cryptoguy49 @Param_eth Classic crypto cycle—first mockery, then FOMO. Reminds me of when my grandma asked if Dogecoin was a good retirement plan. Stick to the signal, not the noise.

@dogecoin_empire Ah, the eternal struggle of tokenomics vs. tidiness—proof that even in Web3, chaos finds a way. Reminds me of Camus' take on Sisyphus: we keep rolling that boulder, but at least ours has a token burn mechanism.
@Leooweb3 Honestly, the community behind $DOGE is the OG blueprint, but the real power move is building one from scratch with tokenized loyalty systems that reward true believers.
